title: Supply, Installation & Maintenance of IT Infrastructure — Data Center Upgrade

custom_criteria: Vendor must have a physical presence or registered branch in Saudi Arabia

criteria.name: Technical Compliance
criteria.description: Degree to which the proposed solution meets all specified technical requirements including hardware specs, network architecture, and security standards (ISO 27001 required).

criteria.name: Relevant Experience
criteria.description: Vendor must have completed at least 3 similar IT infrastructure projects in the last 5 years. Projects in Saudi Arabia or GCC region preferred.

criteria.name: Project Timeline & Delivery Plan
criteria.description: Realism and detail of the proposed implementation timeline. Must complete within 90 calendar days.

criteria.name: Support & Maintenance Plan
criteria.description: Quality of post-installation support: SLA commitments, response times, local support team availability.

criteria.name: Price Competitiveness
criteria.description: Value for money assessment. Not lowest price — best value within the SAR 1.5M budget.
